question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping maintains firm control over the Chinese Communist Party and military through ongoing elite purges, institutional reforms, and the absence of visible challengers or a designated successor ahead of the 2027 Party Congress. Recent developments, including high-level removals in the People's Liberation Army and continued emphasis on personal authority in official messaging, reinforce trader assessments that no leadership transition will occur before 2027. This near-certain consensus reflects the structural barriers to removal in China's political system, where the leader's dominance over key institutions has persisted despite economic pressures and occasional external speculation. Realistic shifts could still arise from sudden health developments, unexpected elite realignments during pre-Congress preparations, or a major crisis eroding internal support.
